name: Ophelia
message: I thought I'd lost you. Maybe forever. And I was so scared.

name: Polonius
message: I won't be executed. Not over this. This is merely Claudius's pettier side at work. Rest assured of that.

name: Polonius
message: Unfortunately, for now, I must ask you leave me be. I don't want you caught up in all this. The King mustn't see you speaking with me.

name: Polonius
message: It's a key. It opens the chest in my room. I keep—kept—it on me at all times.

name: Polonius
message: This chest cannot be opened via any other method. It contained those notes, but they're long gone now.

name: Polonius
message: Please take it. If Bernardo finds it, then they'll surely search my room, yours, and Laertes'. And I don't want to give them cause to do that.

name: Ophelia
message: (So Father has a key on him. Perhaps, in the future, there's a way to examine that chest before it comes to this...)

name: Ophelia
message: At least for now... my father is alive. That's what matters.

name: Ophelia
message: I'm not going to be able to save Father every time. I know that. There is so much that needs to be done.

name: Ophelia
message: Unless I find a way to stop whoever's killing me, Father and I can never survive together and live on.

name: Ophelia
message: I'll just be returned to the beginning again... and Hamlet will still be a threat to Father's life.
